name: Anthony Perry
office: City of Compton, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Anthony Perry is a community organizer, educator, and small business owner, according to his campaign. At a candidates' forum, he said Compton is not a healthy city. He said leaders should operate with integrity and focus on constituents.

sentences.text: Anthony Perry is a community organizer, educator, and small business owner, according to his campaign.
At a candidates' forum, he said Compton is not a healthy city.
He said leaders should operate with integrity and focus on constituents.

items.text: His campaign says he would prioritize fair access to affordable housing, quality education and green spaces. He has proposed workforce training for green industries and support for small businesses. His platform includes youth programs and neighborhood safety through enhanced policing and community engagement.
